Angry '''Vampyre Juvinates''' used to be a possible result of using a [[Guthix balance potion]] on a [[Vampyre Juvinate]]. This form of vampyre is aggressive and stronger, but can be killed with any weapon. They are also slightly taller than a human. Strangely, they look like a [[vampyre juvenile]] in [[Meiyerditch]]. They lived east of [[Burgh de Rott]]. All vampyres become [[angry vampyre]]s now.
